name: Caustic Shower
description: Contact with the doors, pillars, or statue causes a shower of acid.
disable: DC 48 Crafting check (master) to ground the charged features or DC 50 Thievery check (legendary) to disable the contact sensors

offensiveAbilities.name: Acid Shower
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the doors, pillars, or statue directly or with a tool

Effect A shower of acid rains down from the ceiling, dealing 8d10+48 acid damage to all creatures in the chamber (DC 44 basic Reflex save). On a critical failure, a creature additionally takes 1d10 persistent plus acid damage.
